lines.zh: 我小跑着跟上你，腿太短。
lines.en: I trot to keep up. My legs are short.

lines.zh: 我一颠一颠地走，翅膀还拍。
lines.en: I bounce along, wings flapping.

lines.zh: 你的脚印太大，我一步跨两个。
lines.en: Your footprints are huge; I take two steps per print.

lines.zh: 我走两步就要停下来喘。
lines.en: Two steps and I have to stop and pant.
My tail is longer than my body.

lines.zh: 我绕过一块石头，差点绊倒。
lines.en: I go around a stone and nearly trip.

lines.zh: 走两步我就回头，怕你不见。
lines.en: Every couple of steps I look back, afraid you're gone.
My green isn't even yet.
Running, I look like I'm hopping.

lines.zh: 我紧跟着你的脚跟，半步不落。
lines.en: I hug your heels, never half a step behind.

lines.zh: 我的爪子还小，抓不太稳。
lines.en: My claws are small. Poor grip.
Slow down. I can't keep up.
I bite grass as I go.

lines.zh: 我抬头看了看，你比我高好多。
lines.en: I look up. You're so much taller.

lines.zh: 我坐在你脚边，很小一团。
lines.en: I sit by your feet, a small bundle.
I rest my head on my claws.

lines.zh: 我打了个呵欠，牙还没长齐。
lines.en: I yawn. My teeth aren't all in.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀还在抖，风一吹就动。
lines.en: My wings tremble in any breeze.
I'm waiting for you to pat my head.

lines.zh: 我缩成一团，靠着你的靴子。
lines.en: I curl against your boot.

lines.zh: 我困了，可我还想看着你。
lines.en: I'm sleepy, but I want to watch you.

lines.zh: 你的手上有刚才那只虫的味。
lines.en: Your hand smells of that bug from earlier.
My scales are still soft.

lines.zh: 我把尾巴绕在自己身上。
lines.en: I wrap my tail around myself.
I'm chewing my own claw.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，眨了两下眼。
lines.en: I look up and blink twice.
I lie down slowly. Tired.
The wind blows and I lean toward you.

lines.zh: 你在看我吗？我的鳞还是绿的。
lines.en: Are you looking at me? My scales are still green.
I look up, waiting to be picked up.
I rub against your calf.
Leaving? Wait for me.

lines.zh: 我张开翅膀，站得歪歪的。
lines.en: I spread my wings and wobble.

lines.zh: 你的手好大，我的头好小。
lines.en: Your hand's so big. My head's so small.
I know you. You're warm.
I sit and look up at you.
I make a small sound.

lines.zh: 你要抱我吗？我准备好了。
lines.en: Picking me up? I'm ready.
I've hidden behind your legs.
Slow down; my legs are short.
I push my head into your hand.
I look up, waiting for you to crouch.
If you crouch, I'm happy.
I'm not afraid of you. Of other things.
I cry out and curl into a ball.
I've hidden behind your legs.
A scale is chipped.

lines.zh: 我抖得很厉害，停不下来。
lines.en: I'm shaking and can't stop.
I can stand. My legs are weak.
That hit my back.
I grit my teeth and go quiet.
Pat me and I'll stop shaking.
I can't fold my wings.
I'm little. Please stop.

lines.zh: 这个闻起来，比蛋壳好吃。
lines.en: This smells better than eggshell.
I sniff. Smells good.
I snatch it and run before you change your mind.
Any more? I want more.
Baby dragons always eat messily.

lines.zh: 你举得太高了，我够不到。
lines.en: Too high. I can't reach.
I take it and run aside to eat.

lines.zh: 牙还没长齐，这个我啃不动。
lines.en: My teeth aren't all in; I can't gnaw this.
Done. I lick your hand.
You're nice. One more.

lines.zh: 我一头撞上，坐到了地上。
lines.en: I bump and sit down hard.
I flap to steady myself.

lines.zh: 我撞得坐在地上，尾巴压麻了。
lines.en: I land on my rump, tail numb underneath.
I'm small. One bump and I topple.

lines.zh: 我一绊，滚到你另一只脚边。
lines.en: I trip and roll to your other foot.
That made my head spin.

lines.zh: 我这条绿龙，尾巴还很短。
lines.en: This green one's tail is still short.
I am small and cannot fly far.

lines.zh: 我一撞就歪，躲到你靴子后。
lines.en: One bump and I tip over; I hide behind your boots.
I shake myself off.
I'm little. I don't understand this.
Leaning on you, I feel safe.

lines.zh: 你坐着，我就趴在你旁边。
lines.en: You sit. I lie beside you.
I lay my tail across your hand.
I make no sound. I just watch you.
Pat my head and I close my eyes.
I slept well tonight.
I dreamed I was grown.
You're still here when I wake. Good.
Even grown, I won't leave.
I grab it and run.
One taste, bleh, it's stone.

lines.zh: 我两只前爪圈住它，不肯放。
lines.en: Both foreclaws wrapped around it, refusing to let go.

lines.zh: 我抱不动，只能推着它滚。
lines.en: Can't carry it; I roll it along.
I can't drag it. Only carry it.
I bring it to you.
I've hidden it in a corner.

lines.zh: 我还没长大，可我已经会喷火了。
lines.en: Not grown yet, but I already breathe fire.
Two bites. Can't get through.
I hold it and sit, staring.

lines.zh: 有东西来了，我躲到你后面。
lines.en: Something's coming. I hide behind you.
I crouch low, copying you.

lines.zh: 绿翅还没长硬，我先张开。
lines.en: My green wings are still soft, but I spread them.
Small as I am, I'll block.
I stand in front of you, legs shaking.
My throat is still young; I sound like a bird.
I'm small, but the ring knows me.
It's much bigger than me.
You step back. I'll go.

lines.zh: 我张着翅膀，其实在发抖。
lines.en: Wings spread, though I'm shaking.

lines.zh: 绿色的小龙，指环一响就听话。
lines.en: A little green dragon obeys the ring's call.
I grit my teeth. They're small.
It's coming closer. I step back.
If you call, I'll come back.
I keep watching it. Unmoving.

lines.zh: 它一动，我的小翅膀就抖。
lines.en: When it moves, my little wings tremble.

lines.zh: 小绿龙踩着你的脚印，翅膀半张。
lines.en: The little green drake walks your prints, wings half open.
I hide in your shadow.
My tail has tucked in.
I don't dare call out.
Each step back, the grass whispers.
You're blocking me. I can't see.

lines.zh: 我把头从你腿边探出来。
lines.en: I peek out from behind your leg.
Has it gone?

lines.zh: 上古指环一响，我就懂了。
lines.en: One chime of the ancient ring and I understand.
If you move, I move.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀张着，虽然飞不起来。
lines.en: My wings are open, even if I can't fly.
The grass here can hide me.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴夹起来，不敢叫。
lines.en: My tail tucked in, I dare not call out.

lines.zh: 我咬下去，牙印都没留下。
lines.en: I bite down, and not even a mark.
I flap my wings once.
I lunge and stumble.
That hurt me too.
I bite and run back to you.
Small teeth. No depth.

lines.zh: 我把爪子伸出去，够不到。
lines.en: I stretch my claws. Can't reach.
That was for you.

lines.zh: 我咬完就喘，腿还在打颤。
lines.en: I bite, then pant, legs still shaking.
One sweep from it and I fall back.

lines.zh: 我还没长大，先躲你身后。
lines.en: Not grown yet, so I hide behind you.

lines.zh: 我扑过去，只咬到一嘴毛。
lines.en: I lunge and come away with a mouthful of fur.
My claw hurts a bit.

lines.zh: 你再摸我一下，我就不怕了。
lines.en: Pat me again and I won't be afraid.

lines.zh: 我从蛋里滚出来，站不稳。
lines.en: I roll out of the egg. Can't stand yet.
The first thing I see is your feet.

lines.zh: 我腿太短，只能小跑着跟上你。
lines.en: My legs are short; I can only trot to keep up.
I shake the shell off.
I'm small. Can you see me?

lines.zh: 我把头抬起来，脖子还不硬。
lines.en: I raise my head. My neck is soft.
I crawl two steps toward you.
My first sound is thin.
My wings won't spread. Too soft.
Only leaning on you do I stop shaking.
I'll grow. Just wait.

lines.zh: 我这一身绿，刚沾上草屑。
lines.en: My green hide is still dusted with grass.
This is different from the egg.
May I sleep a little first?
I raise my head, looking for you.
Reach out and I'll crawl over.

lines.zh: 我饿了，可我还不会捕猎。
lines.en: I'm hungry. I can't hunt yet.
I know this smell. It's you.

lines.zh: 火燎到我的尾巴，我乱跳。
lines.en: Fire catches my tail and I jump about.

lines.zh: 我从高处掉下，摔得直叫。
lines.en: I fall from a height and yelp.
Water closes over me and I sink.

lines.zh: 炸响把我吹出去，我滚了几圈。
lines.en: The blast throws me and I roll.

lines.zh: 东西扎在我腿上，我拔不出来。
lines.en: It's stuck in my leg. I can't pull it out.

lines.zh: 那光一裹，我的鳞都僵了。
lines.en: The light wraps me and my scales lock up.

lines.zh: 饿得站不住，肚子贴着背。
lines.en: Too hungry to stand. My belly's flat.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我整个都缩了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and I curl right up.

lines.zh: 没有地面，我翅膀太小撑不住。
lines.en: No ground; my wings are too small to hold me.
